lead_independence.headline: Martin County reviews shark fishing rules after state directive to align with Florida law
lead_independence.lead: The Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission asked the county to bring its ordinance in line with state law, which preempts counties from regulating saltwater fishing. Assistant County Attorney Melissa Petrick said state statute has preempted the powers from the county to regulate saltwater fishing that includes shark fishing. State law requires a saltwater fishing license and a special permit for shark fishing. It also allows shark fishing within 1,000 feet of a guarded beach at all hours.
